subject: Private Offer — three-year flex pricing and buyer sign-off plan
messages:

To: sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exploring a private offer for Nova — 3 year term options

Hi Sean / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Nova is interested in moving to a Private Offer on AWS Marketplace for the pilot-to-production rollout. Procurement asked me to consolidate a couple of items before we loop them in:

- Pricing: can you share a few structured options for a 3-year term (annual prepaid, annual invoiced, and a flex consumption+commit model)?
- Buyer approval path: what approvals do you typically see from finance/procurement for co-sell private offers? Any artifacts that speed sign-off?
- Activation: lead time to activate a private offer once a PO is in place.

We’re trying to map this to our internal governance so we can provide a clean ask to procurement and legal. I can bring in the procurement lead if you prefer.

Attaching a short RFP outline (RFP_Request.pdf) so you can see their standard fields.

Best,
Alicia Romero
Head of Platform Partnerships
Nova Enterprises
Attachments: RFP_Request.pdf (application/pdf)
From: sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Romero <alicia.romero@novaenterprises.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Jun 2028 10:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring a private offer for Nova — 3 year term options

Alicia — thanks for the clear ask and the RFP. Looping Ben to help with the pricing band details; Vanessa will coordinate the Marketplace activation.

High level we can present three options for a 3-year Private Offer on AWS Marketplace:

1) Annual prepaid (best unit economics): upfront annual payment, standard 12-month renewal windows, lowest effective $/token.
2) Annual invoiced (invoice net 30/45): similar pricing to prepaid less a small premium to account for credit risk.
3) Flex commit: blended minimum annual commit + overage metered at a lower incremental rate — useful when usage growth is uncertain.

For each option we’ll provide: list price, effective discounted $/unit, suggested AWS Marketplace configuration (term, billing frequency, invoice vs PO), and recommended internal approvals path. See attached initial offer draft (RDW_PrivateOffer_Nova_v1.pdf) and an anonymized price-modeling-sheet.

Regarding approval path — most mid-market buyers route private offers through: procurement -> legal -> finance (CFO/FP&A) for >$250k ARR equivalent. If this maps to Nova’s thresholds, expect a 3–6 week review depending on contract terms and custom SSO/KMS requirements. Having a short summary (1 pager) with activation steps and data-security bullets significantly speeds legal review.

Next steps: Ben will send the pricing bands and a recommended Marketplace config by EOD; Vanessa will outline activation timing. Can you confirm the procurement contact to include?

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: RDW_PrivateOffer_Nova_v1.pdf (application/pdf); price-modeling-sheet.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Subject: Re: Exploring a private offer for Nova — 3 year term options

Thanks Sean — that framework is helpful. Adding our procurement lead for the formal packet:
Jason Lee <jason.lee@novaenterprises.com> (Procurement Manager)

Jason — hi, we’re evaluating Redwood for enterprise inference and would like a formal Private Offer quote and conversation about activation timing and invoice terms. Please see Sean’s note and the attached RFP.

A couple of procurement-specific asks up front:
- Can Redwood accept net-45 on annual invoiced arrangements?
- Do you provide an activation SLA for Marketplace private offers (time-to-activation after PO acceptance)?
- For the flex commit option, do you have a standard mechanism for monthly reconciliation and overage invoices?

I’ve attached our procurement questionnaire (Nova_Procurement_Questionnaire.pdf) so you can pre-fill items.

Best,
Alicia

Subject: Internal: Nova Private Offer — recommend next steps and escalation

Internal only — keeping thread for context.

Quick summary and asks:
- Ben: please finalize the three pricing bands as discussed and produce a one-page summary (list price, effective $/unit, recommended term/billing). Attach RDW_PrivateOffer_Nova_v2.pdf as the formal quote.
- Vanessa: detail Marketplace activation timeline. If we can promise activation within 5 business days of PO acceptance (assuming no SSO/KMS changes), call that out. If not, state realistic window and blockers.
- Marcus: finance confirmation — can we support net-45 on annual invoiced option or do we need pre-approval from FP&A for >$500k total contract value? If net-45 is acceptable, note any collection risk mitigations.

Goal: present the formal offer and Marketplace configuration to Jason by EOD Friday so procurement has time to review next week. If finance requires a sign-off path that will push activation, advise escalation to regional sales leader.

Thanks team — I’ll draft the email to Jason/Alicia once we have pricing + activation windows.

Sean
